title: jetpacks sci-fi series
description: does not do anything by itself but allows to attach a jetpack to any chestplate using commands
body:
The goal of this datapack is to make the jetpack as easy to use as possible and as useful as possible. So this jetpack could be used in
1. Building: fly up and place a block that is hard to place otherwise
2. Movement: fly up a cliff, or prevent fall damage
3. Combat: keep your distance from an enemy and shoot them with a bow

To control the jetpack:
1. Crouch to fly up!
2. When you stop crouching you will start falling slowly!
3. to fall at normal speed run in midair (press control+W)

this datapack was made for my sci-fi series armour datapack. the only way to obtain the jetpack is using commands add [custom_data={jetpack:true}] to item attributes of a chestplate. 

**!!!does not add crafting recipes for the jetpack!!!**

if you're playing in survival download a datapack that does that like [more armour sci-fi series](https://modrinth.com/datapack/more-armour-sci-fi-series) so you can obtain a jetpack
